# F&F Oil Solutions

> Industrial oil filtration, hydraulic oil dehydration and oil reclamation for manufacturers and equipment operators in the Rio Grande Valley, Texas (McAllen, Edinburg, Mission, Pharr, Weslaco, Harlingen, Brownsville). On-site service. English and Spanish.

- Phone: 956-272-6415
- Email: info@ffoilsolutions.com
- Website (English): https://ffoilsolutions.com/
- Website (Spanish): https://ffoilsolutions.com/es/

## Services
- Industrial oil filtration: Removal of suspended particles from hydraulic, lubricating and other industrial oils.
- Hydraulic oil dehydration: Reduction of free and emulsified water in hydraulic and industrial oils.
- Oil reclamation and conditioning: Evaluation and treatment of used oil to determine whether it can go back into service.
- Oil condition assessment: Initial review of oil type, viscosity, equipment, volume and contamination.
- Oil analysis coordination: Viscosity, ISO 4406 particle count, Karl Fischer water, ICP, FTIR and TAN testing through an outside laboratory.
- Oil filtration equipment rental: Filtration equipment for rent, subject to availability.

## Oils
Hydraulic, lubricating, gear and other industrial oils across ISO VG viscosity grades (for example VG 10 to VG 460). Compatibility is confirmed for each oil and application.

## Notes
Oil is never promised to be reusable before its condition is known. Potential savings vary and are not guaranteed.
